subject: Combine size and colour key when size is transformed

messages.author: 3b242040e3845b6c
messages.subject: Combine size and colour key when size is transformed
parts:
Hello,

I am plotting a PCA plot with size and colour determined by the same
variable, with the size value reversed:
> ggplot(pcaCombo,aes(x=PC1,y=PC2)) + geom_point(aes(color=all_probeset_percent_called,size=all_probeset_percent_called)) + scale_size(trans="reverse")

This produces two keys. If I remove the scale_size command I only get
one key. Is there a way to combine the colour and size key when the
size scale has beed reversed?

Thanks

Dan

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Combine size and colour key when size is transformed
parts:
Hi Dan,

Try manually specifying the breaks for both scales - as long as they
line up, the two scales will get merged.

Hadley
